1. Cosa significa: stato dell'ordine "Non evaso"?

Il tuo ordine non è ancora stato contrassegnato come evaso. Gli ordini vengono generalmente elaborati entro 1-3 giorni lavorativi dalla conferma del pagamento. Le informazioni di tracciamento vengono inviate via email quando disponibili dopo la spedizione.

 

2. Cosa significa: stato ordine "Evaso"?

Questo significa che il tuo ordine è in spedizione.

 

3. È passato troppo tempo, dov'è il mio ordine?

Per favore controlla il tracciamento del tuo ordine per maggiori informazioni. Se il problema persiste, inviaci una email a: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Tracciamento ordine

1. Come posso tracciare il mio ordine?

Le informazioni di tracciamento vengono inviate via email quando disponibili dopo la spedizione dell’ordine. Puoi anche consultare le informazioni di tracciamento qui: Traccia il tuo ordine

 

2. Il mio codice di tracciamento dice "in attesa" o "nessuna informazione disponibile al momento".

L’aggiornamento delle informazioni di tracciamento può richiedere 24-48 ore dall’emissione del numero di tracciamento. Se le informazioni restano non disponibili o il pacco è in ritardo, contattaci: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Il mio codice di tracciamento dice "scaduto"

Per favore contattaci: info@dresslikemommy.com e risolveremo rapidamente questo problema.

 

4. Come posso rimanere aggiornato sul tracciamento del mio ordine?

Usa il link di tracciamento per consultare gli ultimi aggiornamenti del corriere. Se il pacco è in ritardo, smarrito o risulta consegnato ma non lo hai ricevuto, contattaci indicando il numero d’ordine e le informazioni di tracciamento.

B. Voglio cambiare o cancellare il mio ordine

1. Ho ordinato qualcosa, ma voglio cancellare

Devi contattarci entro 1 giorno lavorativo dall'ordine per organizzare una modifica. Puoi farlo inviando una email a info@dresslikemommy.com con il tuo numero d'ordine come oggetto.

 

2. Ho ordinato qualcosa, ma voglio cambiare il colore o la taglia dell'articolo.

Devi contattarci entro 1 giorno lavorativo dall'ordine per organizzare una modifica. Puoi farlo inviando una email a info@dresslikemommy.com con la tua nuova opzione di colore o taglia.

 

3. Ho ordinato qualcosa, ma voglio cambiare l'indirizzo di consegna

Devi contattarci entro 1 giorno lavorativo dall'ordine per organizzare una modifica. Puoi farlo inviando una email a info@dresslikemommy.com con il tuo nuovo indirizzo di consegna.

Dopo aver ricevuto un ordine

A. Voglio cambiare o restituire il mio ordine

1. Il mio ordine è arrivato, ma gli articoli erano di due taglie più grandi

Le etichette delle taglie possono variare. Se la taglia o le misure sembrano non corrispondere al tuo ordine, contatta info@dresslikemommy.com indicando il numero d’ordine e i dettagli. Consulta la nostra attuale politica sui rimborsi prima di rispedire un articolo.

 

2. Il mio ordine è arrivato, ma ho ricevuto gli articoli sbagliati

Per favore contattaci a info@dresslikemommy.com e fornisci il tuo numero d'ordine. Se è colpa nostra, puoi restituirci gli articoli e ti invieremo quelli corretti a nostre spese (o ti rimborseremo).

 

3. Il mio ordine è arrivato e voglio cambiare la taglia/colore

Contattaci all’indirizzo info@dresslikemommy.com e indica il numero d’ordine. I cambi approvati seguono la politica di rimborso vigente, compresi i requisiti sulle condizioni degli articoli e la responsabilità per le spese di spedizione del reso.

 

4. Il mio ordine è arrivato, ma voglio restituirlo.

Contattaci all’indirizzo info@dresslikemommy.com e indica il numero d’ordine. Prima di rispedire qualsiasi articolo, consulta la politica di rimborso per le condizioni di ammissibilità, la spedizione del reso e i tempi di rimborso.

rows.source:
About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Our main operations are carried in European Union accomponied by our Support Centre in Lithuania and Manufacturers and Warehouses in East Asia.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We cut out all the middle men and deliver the products directly to consumers from our manufacturers which allows us to offer extremely low prices.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept PayPal and credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover).

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

We offer free standard shipping on all orders to the destinations listed in our shipping policy.

私たちについて

A. 一般的な質問

1. このサイトは安全に使えますか？

はい、安全です。支払いはPayPalで処理しているため、スタッフもお客様の支払い情報を見ることはありません。PayPalは世界最大の安全な決済プロバイダーです。当サイトはShopifyの安全なプラットフォーム上に構築されており、個人情報は厳重に保護されています。

 

2. メールの問い合わせにはどのくらい早く対応しますか？

すべてのメールには1営業日以内に返信しています。

 

3. どこに拠点がありますか？

主な拠点は欧州連合内にあり、リトアニアのサポートセンターと東アジアの製造工場および倉庫と連携しています。

 

4. なぜこんなに安いのですか？

中間業者を省き、製造元から直接お客様に商品をお届けしているため、非常に低価格で提供できます。

ご注文前に

A. サイズ

1. センチメートル単位のサイズ表はどこで見られますか？

検討中の商品とサイズに対応するサイズ表をご確認ください。単位と、表が体の寸法を示しているのか、衣服の寸法を示しているのかも確認してください。サイズガイドでは、採寸方法とサイズの比較方法をご案内しています。表や寸法がわかりにくい場合は、ご注文前にお問い合わせください。

 

2. 2サイズ大きい商品が届きますか？

サイズ表記や寸法は、商品やメーカーによって異なります。普段着用しているアルファベットのサイズが合うと決めつけたり、固定のサイズ換算を当てはめたりせず、各商品のサイズ表と選択可能なオプションを確認してお選びください。ご不明な点がある場合は、ご注文前にお問い合わせください。

B. 支払い

1. どのような支払い方法が使えますか？

PayPalとクレジット/デビットカード（Visa、Mastercard、American Express、Discover）を受け付けています。

 

2. クレジットカードで支払いたいのにPayPalのページにリダイレクトされますか？

すべての支払いはPayPalで処理しています。PayPalのページ右側で「PayPalアカウントで支払う」または「クレジットカードまたはデビットカードで支払う」の2つのオプションから選べます。

C. 配送

1. 配送料はいくらですか？

世界中どこでも完全無料で配送しています。

 

2. 私の国にも配送していますか？

はい、配送しています。世界中すべての国にお届けします。

 

3. 注文が届くまでどのくらいかかりますか？

配送には通常15〜30日かかります。ただし、正確な配送予定はここでご確認いただけます：配送ページ

 

4. 関税は支払う必要がありますか？

いいえ、関税はお支払いいただく必要はありません。すべての注文を低価格のギフトとして申告しています。さらに、大きな注文は別々のパッケージで発送しています。

ご注文後

A. 注文状況

1. 注文状況「未発送」とはどういう意味ですか？

ご注文は処理中で、注文の追跡番号はまだ保留中です。通常、ご注文が発送された後5〜7日で郵便システムに追跡番号が登録され、その時点でお客様に追跡番号をお知らせしています。

 

2. 注文状況「Fulfilled」とはどういう意味ですか？

これはご注文が発送中であることを意味します。

 

3. かなり時間が経ちましたが、注文はどこにありますか？

詳細はご注文の追跡情報をご確認ください。問題が続く場合はメールでご連絡ください： support@dresslikemommy.com

B. 注文追跡

1. 注文をどうやって追跡しますか？

ご注文後5～7日で追跡コードをお知らせします。こちらでご注文を追跡できます：注文を追跡する

 

2. 追跡コードが「保留中」または「現在情報がありません」と表示されます。

追跡番号を受け取ってから5～10営業日後に最初の追跡結果が表示されることがあります。10営業日以上問題が続く場合はお問い合わせください： support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. 追跡コードが「期限切れ」と表示されます。

お問い合わせはこちらまで： support@dresslikemommy.com 迅速に問題を解決いたします。

 

4. 注文の追跡情報はどうやって確認できますか？

当店ではAfter Ship追跡システムを使用しており、追跡情報が更新されるとメールが届きます。

B. 注文の変更またはキャンセルを希望します。

1. 注文しましたが、キャンセルしたいです。

注文変更の手配は、ご注文後1営業日以内にご連絡ください。メールでご連絡いただけます。 support@dresslikemommy.com 件名にご注文番号を記載してください。

 

2. 注文しましたが、商品の色やサイズを変更したいです。

注文変更の手配は、ご注文後1営業日以内にご連絡ください。メールでご連絡いただけます。 support@dresslikemommy.com 新しい色またはサイズのオプションとともに。

 

3. 注文しましたが、配送先住所を変更したいです。

注文変更の手配は、ご注文後1営業日以内にご連絡ください。メールでご連絡いただけます。 support@dresslikemommy.com 新しい配送先住所とともに。

ご注文後

A. 注文の変更または返品を希望します。

1. 注文した商品が届きましたが、2サイズ大きいものでした。

サイズ表記は異なる場合があります。サイズや寸法がご注文内容と一致しないと思われる場合は、注文番号と詳細を添えて support@dresslikemommy.com までご連絡ください。商品を返送する前に、現在の返金ポリシーをご確認ください。

 

2. 注文した商品が届きましたが、間違った商品が届きました。

お問い合わせはこちらまで support@dresslikemommy.com ご注文番号をお知らせください。こちらのミスの場合は、商品を返品していただければ、正しい商品を当社負担でお送りします（または返金いたします）。

 

3. 注文した商品が届き、サイズや色を変更したいです。

お問い合わせはこちらまで support@dresslikemommy.com ご注文番号をお知らせください。商品を返品していただければ、サイズを変更した新しい商品をお送りします。*送料はお客様のご負担となります。

 

4. 注文した商品が届きましたが、返品したいです。

お問い合わせはこちらまで support@dresslikemommy.com ご注文番号をお知らせください。商品を返品していただければ、返金いたします。*送料はお客様のご負担となります。

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

회사 소개

A. 일반 질문

1. 이 사이트는 안전한가요?

네, 안전합니다. 결제는 PayPal로 처리되며, 직원도 결제 정보를 볼 수 없습니다. PayPal은 세계 최대의 안전 결제 제공업체입니다. 저희 사이트는 Shopify 보안 플랫폼 위에 구축되어 있어 모든 개인정보가 철저히 보호됩니다.

 

2. 이메일 문의에 얼마나 빨리 답변하나요?

모든 이메일에 영업일 기준 하루 이내에 답변합니다.

 

3. 어디에 기반을 두고 있나요?

주요 운영은 유럽 연합에서 이루어지며, 리투아니아에 지원 센터가 있고 동아시아에 제조사와 창고가 있습니다.

 

4. 왜 이렇게 저렴한가요?

중간 유통 과정을 없애고 제조사에서 직접 소비자에게 제품을 배송하여 매우 저렴한 가격을 제공합니다.

주문 전

A. 사이즈

1. 센티미터 단위 사이즈 표는 어디서 찾을 수 있나요?

구매를 고려 중인 해당 상품과 사이즈의 사이즈표를 확인하세요. 측정 단위와 표에 표시된 치수가 신체 치수인지 의류 치수인지도 확인하세요. 사이즈 가이드에서 치수를 재고 사이즈를 비교하는 방법을 안내합니다. 표나 치수가 명확하지 않으면 주문 전에 문의해 주세요.

 

2. 두 사이즈 큰 제품을 받게 되나요?

사이즈 표기와 치수는 상품과 제조사에 따라 다릅니다. 평소 입는 알파벳 사이즈가 맞을 것이라고 가정하거나 고정된 사이즈 변환 규칙을 적용하지 말고, 각 상품의 사이즈표와 선택 가능한 옵션을 확인하여 골라 주세요. 확실하지 않으면 주문 전에 문의해 주세요.

B. 결제

1. 어떤 결제 수단을 받나요?

PayPal과 신용/직불카드(Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover)를 받습니다.

 

2. 신용카드로 결제하려는데 PayPal 페이지로 리디렉션되나요?

저희는 모든 결제를 PayPal로 처리합니다. 오른쪽 PayPal 페이지에서 두 가지 옵션 중 선택할 수 있습니다: "내 PayPal 계정으로 결제" 또는 "신용카드 또는 직불카드로 결제"

C. 배송

1. 배송비는 얼마인가요?

전 세계 어디든 완전 무료 배송을 제공합니다.

 

2. 제 나라로 배송하나요?

네, 전 세계 모든 국가로 배송합니다.

 

3. 내 주문은 얼마나 걸리나요?

배송은 보통 15-30일 정도 걸립니다. 하지만 정확한 배송 예상일은 여기에서 확인하실 수 있습니다: 배송 페이지

 

4. 관세를 내야 하나요?

아니요, 관세를 지불하실 필요 없습니다. 저희는 모든 주문을 저가 선물로 표시합니다. 또한, 큰 주문은 별도의 패키지로 발송합니다.

주문 후

A. 주문 상태

1. 주문 상태 "미처리"는 무슨 뜻인가요?

주문이 처리 중이며 주문의 운송장 번호는 아직 대기 중입니다. 보통 주문이 배송된 후 5-7일 이내에 우편 시스템에 운송장 번호가 등록되면 고객님께 운송장 번호를 보내드립니다.

 

2. 주문 상태 "완료"는 무슨 뜻인가요?

주문이 배송 중임을 의미합니다.

 

3. 너무 오래 걸렸는데 내 주문은 어디 있나요?

더 자세한 정보는 주문 추적을 확인해 주세요. 문제가 계속되면 이메일로 문의해 주세요: support@dresslikemommy.com

B. 주문 추적

1. 주문을 어떻게 추적하나요?

주문 후 5-7일 후에 추적 코드를 제공합니다. 여기에서 주문을 추적할 수 있습니다: 주문 추적

 

2. 내 추적 코드가 “대기 중” 또는 “현재 정보 없음”이라고 나와요.

가끔 주문 추적 번호를 받은 후 5-10 영업일 후에 첫 추적 결과가 나타납니다. 10영업일 이상 문제가 지속되면 연락해 주세요: support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. 내 추적 코드가 “만료됨”이라고 나와요.

문의는 다음으로 연락해 주세요: support@dresslikemommy.com 문제를 신속히 해결해 드리겠습니다.

 

4. 주문 추적 정보를 어떻게 확인하나요?

저희는 After Ship 추적 시스템을 사용하여 고객 주문을 추적하므로, 추적 정보가 업데이트되면 이메일을 받으실 수 있습니다.

B. 주문을 변경하거나 취소하고 싶어요.

1. 주문했는데 취소하고 싶어요.

주문 변경을 원하시면 주문 후 1영업일 이내에 연락해 주세요. 이메일로 연락하실 수 있습니다. support@dresslikemommy.com 주문 번호를 제목으로 하여.

 

2. 주문했는데 상품 색상이나 사이즈를 변경하고 싶어요.

주문 변경을 원하시면 주문 후 1영업일 이내에 연락해 주세요. 이메일로 연락하실 수 있습니다. support@dresslikemommy.com 새로운 색상 또는 사이즈 옵션과 함께.

 

3. 주문했는데 배송 주소를 변경하고 싶어요.

주문 변경을 원하시면 주문 후 1영업일 이내에 연락해 주세요. 이메일로 연락하실 수 있습니다. support@dresslikemommy.com 새 배송 주소와 함께.

주문을 받으신 후

A. 주문을 변경하거나 반품하고 싶어요.

1. 주문한 상품이 도착했는데 두 사이즈 크게 왔어요.

사이즈 표기는 다를 수 있습니다. 사이즈나 치수가 주문 내용과 일치하지 않는 것으로 보이면 주문 번호와 자세한 내용을 적어 support@dresslikemommy.com 으로 문의해 주세요. 상품을 반송하기 전에 현재 환불 정책을 확인하세요.

 

2. 주문한 상품이 도착했는데 잘못된 상품이 왔어요.

문의는 다음으로 연락해 주세요 support@dresslikemommy.com 주문 번호를 알려주세요. 당사 과실일 경우 상품을 반품하시면 올바른 상품을 당사 비용으로 보내드리거나 환불해 드립니다.

 

3. 주문한 상품이 도착했는데 사이즈/색상을 변경하고 싶어요.

문의는 다음으로 연락해 주세요 support@dresslikemommy.com 주문 번호를 알려주세요. 상품을 반품하시면 업데이트된 사이즈의 새 상품을 보내드립니다. *배송비는 고객 부담입니다.

 

4. 주문한 상품이 도착했는데 반품하고 싶어요.

문의는 다음으로 연락해 주세요 support@dresslikemommy.com 주문 번호를 알려주세요. 상품을 반품하시면 환불해 드립니다. *배송비는 고객 부담입니다.

Dress Like Mommy는 미국 플로리다주 네이플스에 있는 FKG Trading LLC가 운영하는 온라인 스토어입니다. 제조 및 주문 처리·배송 파트너와 협력하고 있습니다.

 

4. 왜 이렇게 저렴한가요?

합리적인 가격을 고려하여 온 가족이 함께 입을 수 있는 패밀리룩을 선정합니다. 가격과 적용 가능한 할인은 상품 페이지와 결제 단계에 표시됩니다.

주문 전

A. 사이즈

1. 센티미터 단위 사이즈 표는 어디서 찾을 수 있나요?

구매를 고려 중인 해당 상품과 사이즈의 사이즈표를 확인하세요. 측정 단위와 표에 표시된 치수가 신체 치수인지 의류 치수인지도 확인하세요. 사이즈 가이드에서 치수를 재고 사이즈를 비교하는 방법을 안내합니다. 표나 치수가 명확하지 않으면 주문 전에 문의해 주세요.

 

2. 두 사이즈 큰 제품을 받게 되나요?

사이즈 표기와 치수는 상품과 제조사에 따라 다릅니다. 평소 입는 알파벳 사이즈가 맞을 것이라고 가정하거나 고정된 사이즈 변환 규칙을 적용하지 말고, 각 상품의 사이즈표와 선택 가능한 옵션을 확인하여 골라 주세요. 확실하지 않으면 주문 전에 문의해 주세요.

B. 결제

1. 어떤 결제 수단을 받나요?

이용 가능한 카드 결제를 비롯하여 결제 단계에 표시되는 결제 수단을 사용할 수 있습니다.

 

2. 신용카드로 결제하려는데 PayPal 페이지로 리디렉션되나요?

결제 단계에서 이용 가능한 결제 수단을 선택하세요. 외부 결제 서비스를 선택한 경우 해당 업체의 안내를 따르거나, 결제하기 전에 다른 이용 가능한 수단을 선택하세요.

C. 배송

1. 배송비는 얼마인가요?

일반 배송을 이용할 수 있는 국가와 지역에서는 상품 가격에 일반 배송비가 포함됩니다. 결제 전 결제 단계에서 정확한 배송 방법, 예상 배송일 및 이용 가능한 특급 배송 업그레이드를 확인할 수 있습니다.

 

2. 제 나라로 배송하나요?

결제 화면에 표시되는 국가와 지역으로 배송합니다. 결제 화면에 고객님의 국가가 표시되지 않으면 주문 전에 문의해 주세요.

 

3. 내 주문은 얼마나 걸리나요?

주문 처리 및 운송 기간은 배송지와 배송업체에 따라 다릅니다. 결제 전에 배송 정책에서 최신 배송 정보를 확인하세요.

 

4. 관세를 내야 하나요?

배송지 국가에서 관세, 수입세 또는 현지 수수료를 부과할 수 있으며, 결제 화면에 포함되어 있다고 명시된 경우를 제외하고 해당 비용은 고객 부담입니다. 주문을 선물로 표시하거나 실제보다 낮은 금액의 배송품으로 신고할 수 없습니다.

주문 후

A. 주문 상태

1. 주문 상태 "미처리"는 무슨 뜻인가요?

아직 주문 처리 완료로 표시되지 않은 상태입니다. 주문은 일반적으로 결제 확인 후 1-3영업일 이내에 처리됩니다. 배송 조회 정보는 발송 후 확인이 가능해지면 이메일로 안내합니다.

 

2. 주문 상태 "완료"는 무슨 뜻인가요?

주문이 배송 중임을 의미합니다.

 

3. 너무 오래 걸렸는데 내 주문은 어디 있나요?

더 자세한 정보는 주문 추적을 확인해 주세요. 문제가 계속되면 이메일로 문의해 주세요: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. 주문 추적

1. 주문을 어떻게 추적하나요?

배송 조회 정보는 주문 발송 후 확인이 가능해지면 이메일로 안내합니다. 여기에서도 배송 정보를 조회할 수 있습니다: 주문 배송 조회

 

2. 내 추적 코드가 “대기 중” 또는 “현재 정보 없음”이라고 나와요.

운송장 번호가 발급된 후 배송 조회 정보가 업데이트되기까지 24-48시간이 걸릴 수 있습니다. 계속 정보가 표시되지 않거나 배송이 지연되는 경우 문의해 주세요: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. 내 추적 코드가 “만료됨”이라고 나와요.

문의는 다음으로 연락해 주세요: info@dresslikemommy.com 문제를 신속히 해결해 드리겠습니다.

 

4. 주문 추적 정보를 어떻게 확인하나요?

배송 조회 링크에서 배송업체의 최신 정보를 확인하세요. 배송이 지연되거나 상품이 분실된 경우, 또는 배송 완료로 표시되지만 상품을 받지 못한 경우에는 주문 번호와 배송 조회 정보를 알려 주시고 문의해 주세요.

B. 주문을 변경하거나 취소하고 싶어요.

1. 주문했는데 취소하고 싶어요.

주문 변경을 원하시면 주문 후 1영업일 이내에 연락해 주세요. 이메일로 연락하실 수 있습니다. info@dresslikemommy.com 주문 번호를 제목으로 하여.

 

2. 주문했는데 상품 색상이나 사이즈를 변경하고 싶어요.

주문 변경을 원하시면 주문 후 1영업일 이내에 연락해 주세요. 이메일로 연락하실 수 있습니다. info@dresslikemommy.com 새로운 색상 또는 사이즈 옵션과 함께.

 

3. 주문했는데 배송 주소를 변경하고 싶어요.

주문 변경을 원하시면 주문 후 1영업일 이내에 연락해 주세요. 이메일로 연락하실 수 있습니다. info@dresslikemommy.com 새 배송 주소와 함께.

주문을 받으신 후

A. 주문을 변경하거나 반품하고 싶어요.

1. 주문한 상품이 도착했는데 두 사이즈 크게 왔어요.

사이즈 표기는 다를 수 있습니다. 사이즈나 치수가 주문 내용과 일치하지 않는 것으로 보이면 주문 번호와 자세한 내용을 적어 info@dresslikemommy.com 으로 문의해 주세요. 상품을 반송하기 전에 현재 환불 정책을 확인하세요.

 

2. 주문한 상품이 도착했는데 잘못된 상품이 왔어요.

문의는 다음으로 연락해 주세요 info@dresslikemommy.com 주문 번호를 알려주세요. 당사 과실일 경우 상품을 반품하시면 올바른 상품을 당사 비용으로 보내드리거나 환불해 드립니다.

 

3. 주문한 상품이 도착했는데 사이즈/색상을 변경하고 싶어요.

info@dresslikemommy.com으로 연락하여 주문 번호를 알려 주세요. 승인된 교환에는 상품 상태 요건과 반품 배송비 부담을 포함한 현재 환불 정책이 적용됩니다.

 

4. 주문한 상품이 도착했는데 반품하고 싶어요.

info@dresslikemommy.com으로 연락하여 주문 번호를 알려 주세요. 상품을 반송하기 전에 환불 정책에서 반품 가능 조건, 반품 배송 및 환불 처리 기간을 확인하세요.

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept PayPal and credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover).

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

We use PayPal to process all our payments. In the PayPal page on the right you can select from two options: "Pay with my PayPal account" or "Pay with my credit or debit card"

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

We offer free standard shipping on all orders to the destinations listed in our shipping policy.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We currently ship to the countries listed in our shipping policy. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order is being processed and the order's tracking number is pending. We usually fulfil the orders and send our customers the tracking number when the order's tracking number is submitted to the Postal System, which takes 5-7 days after the order is already shipped.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: support@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

We provide the order's tracking code 5-7 days after you place an order. You can track your order here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Sometimes the first tracking results appear 5-10 business days after you receive the order's tracking number. If the problem remains for more than 10 business days, please contact us: support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: support@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

We use After Ship tracking system to track our customers orders, so whenever the tracking information is updated, you should receive an email.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing support@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing support@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing support@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact support@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at support@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at support@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at support@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

Over ons

A. Algemene vragen

1. Is deze site veilig in gebruik?

Dat is het zeker. We gebruiken PayPal om betalingen te verwerken. Dus zelfs ons personeel ziet je betalingsgegevens niet. PayPal is de grootste beveiligde betalingsprovider ter wereld. Onze website is gebouwd op het beveiligde Shopify-platform. Al je persoonlijke informatie is goed beveiligd.

 

2. Hoe snel reageren jullie op e-mailvragen?

We beantwoorden alle e-mails binnen één werkdag.

 

3. Waar zijn jullie gevestigd?

Onze hoofdactiviteiten vinden plaats in de Europese Unie, ondersteund door ons Supportcentrum in Litouwen en fabrikanten en magazijnen in Oost-Azië.

 

4. Waarom zijn jullie zo goedkoop?

We schakelen alle tussenpersonen uit en leveren de producten rechtstreeks aan consumenten van onze fabrikanten, waardoor we extreem lage prijzen kunnen bieden.

Voordat je een bestelling plaatst

A. Maten

1. Waar kan ik de maattabel in centimeters vinden?

Gebruik de maattabel voor het specifieke product en de maat die je overweegt. Controleer de eenheden en of de tabel lichaamsmaten of kledingmaten vermeldt. Onze maatgids legt uit hoe je meet en maten vergelijkt. Neem vóór het bestellen contact met ons op als een tabel of maat onduidelijk is.

 

2. Krijg ik een artikel dat twee maten groter is?

Maatlabels en afmetingen verschillen per product en fabrikant. Kies elk kledingstuk aan de hand van de eigen maattabel en de beschikbare opties, in plaats van uit te gaan van je gebruikelijke lettermaat of een vaste maatomrekening toe te passen. Neem bij twijfel vóór het bestellen contact met ons op.

B. Betalingen

1. Welke betaalmethoden accepteren jullie?

We accepteren PayPal en creditcards/debetkaarten (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover).

 

2. Ik wil met mijn creditcard betalen, maar ik word doorgestuurd naar de PayPal-pagina?

We gebruiken PayPal om al onze betalingen te verwerken. Op de PayPal-pagina rechts kun je kiezen uit twee opties: "Betalen met mijn PayPal-account" of "Betalen met mijn creditcard of betaalpas"

C. Verzending

1. Wat is de verzendprijs?

We bieden absoluut GRATIS levering wereldwijd.

 

2. Levert u in mijn land?

Ja, dat doen we. We leveren aan alle landen wereldwijd.

 

3. Hoe lang duurt het voordat ik mijn bestelling ontvang?

De levering duurt meestal ongeveer 15-30 dagen. Je kunt echter de exacte levertijd hier controleren: Verzendpagina

 

4. Moet ik douanekosten betalen?

Nee, je hoeft geen douanekosten te betalen. We markeren al onze bestellingen als cadeaus met lage waarde. Bovendien sturen we grotere bestellingen in aparte pakketten.

Nadat je een bestelling hebt geplaatst

A. Orderstatus

1. Wat betekent de orderstatus "Onvervuld"?

Je bestelling wordt verwerkt en het trackingnummer van de bestelling is nog in afwachting. We verwerken de bestellingen meestal en sturen onze klanten het trackingnummer zodra het trackingnummer aan het postsysteem is doorgegeven, wat 5-7 dagen duurt nadat de bestelling al is verzonden.

 

2. Wat betekent de orderstatus "Voltooid"?

Dat betekent dat uw bestelling wordt verzonden.

 

3. Het duurt te lang, waar is mijn bestelling?

Controleer alstublieft de tracking van uw bestelling voor meer informatie. Als het probleem blijft bestaan, stuur dan een e-mail naar: support@dresslikemommy.com

B. Ordertracking

1. Hoe kan ik mijn bestelling volgen?

Wij verstrekken de trackingcode van de bestelling 5-7 dagen nadat u een bestelling heeft geplaatst. U kunt uw bestelling hier volgen: Volg uw bestelling

 

2. Mijn trackingcode zegt “in afwachting” of “momenteel geen informatie beschikbaar”.

Soms verschijnen de eerste trackingresultaten 5-10 werkdagen nadat u het trackingnummer van de bestelling heeft ontvangen. Als het probleem langer dan 10 werkdagen aanhoudt, neem dan contact met ons op: support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Mijn trackingcode zegt “verlopen”

Neem alstublieft contact met ons op: support@dresslikemommy.com en wij lossen dit probleem snel voor u op.

 

4. Hoe blijf ik op de hoogte van mijn ordertracking?

Wij gebruiken het After Ship-tracking systeem om de bestellingen van onze klanten te volgen, dus wanneer de trackinginformatie wordt bijgewerkt, ontvangt u een e-mail.

B. Ik wil mijn bestelling wijzigen of annuleren

1. Ik heb iets besteld, maar ik wil annuleren

U moet binnen 1 werkdag na het plaatsen van de bestelling contact met ons opnemen om een wijziging te regelen. Dit kunt u doen door een e-mail te sturen naar support@dresslikemommy.com met uw bestelnummer als onderwerp.

 

2. Ik heb iets besteld, maar wil de kleur of maat van het artikel wijzigen.

U moet binnen 1 werkdag na het plaatsen van de bestelling contact met ons opnemen om een wijziging te regelen. Dit kunt u doen door een e-mail te sturen naar support@dresslikemommy.com met uw nieuwe kleur- of maatoptie.

 

3. Ik heb iets besteld, maar wil het afleveradres wijzigen

U moet binnen 1 werkdag na het plaatsen van de bestelling contact met ons opnemen om een wijziging te regelen. Dit kunt u doen door een e-mail te sturen naar support@dresslikemommy.com met uw nieuwe afleveradres.

Nadat u een bestelling heeft ontvangen

A. Ik wil mijn bestelling wijzigen of retourneren

1. Mijn bestelling is aangekomen, maar de artikelen waren twee maten te groot

Maatlabels kunnen verschillen. Als de maat of afmetingen niet lijken overeen te komen met je bestelling, neem dan contact op via support@dresslikemommy.com en vermeld je bestelnummer en de details. Lees ons huidige terugbetalingsbeleid voordat je een artikel terugstuurt.

 

2. Mijn bestelling is aangekomen, maar ik heb de verkeerde artikelen ontvangen

Neem alstublieft contact met ons op via support@dresslikemommy.com en geef ons uw bestelnummer door. Als wij in fout zijn, kunt u de artikelen naar ons terugsturen en sturen wij u de juiste artikelen op onze kosten (of betalen wij het bedrag terug).

 

3. Mijn bestelling is aangekomen en ik wil de maat/kleur wijzigen

Neem alstublieft contact met ons op via support@dresslikemommy.com en geef ons uw bestelnummer door. U kunt het artikel naar ons terugsturen en wij sturen u een nieuw artikel in de juiste maat. *Verzendkosten zijn voor uw rekening.

 

4. Mijn bestelling is aangekomen, maar ik wil het retourneren.

Neem alstublieft contact met ons op via support@dresslikemommy.com en geef ons uw bestelnummer door. U kunt het artikel naar ons terugsturen en wij zullen het aankoopbedrag terugbetalen. *Verzendkosten zijn voor uw rekening.

U moet binnen 1 werkdag na het plaatsen van de bestelling contact met ons opnemen om een wijziging te regelen. Dit kunt u doen door een e-mail te sturen naar info@dresslikemommy.com met uw nieuwe kleur- of maatoptie.

 

3. Ik heb iets besteld, maar wil het afleveradres wijzigen

U moet binnen 1 werkdag na het plaatsen van de bestelling contact met ons opnemen om een wijziging te regelen. Dit kunt u doen door een e-mail te sturen naar info@dresslikemommy.com met uw nieuwe afleveradres.

Nadat u een bestelling heeft ontvangen

A. Ik wil mijn bestelling wijzigen of retourneren

1. Mijn bestelling is aangekomen, maar de artikelen waren twee maten te groot

Maatlabels kunnen verschillen. Als de maat of afmetingen niet lijken overeen te komen met je bestelling, neem dan contact op via info@dresslikemommy.com en vermeld je bestelnummer en de details. Lees ons huidige terugbetalingsbeleid voordat je een artikel terugstuurt.

 

2. Mijn bestelling is aangekomen, maar ik heb de verkeerde artikelen ontvangen

Neem alstublieft contact met ons op via info@dresslikemommy.com en geef ons uw bestelnummer door. Als wij in fout zijn, kunt u de artikelen naar ons terugsturen en sturen wij u de juiste artikelen op onze kosten (of betalen wij het bedrag terug).

rows.source:
About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

3. Where are you based?

Our main operations are carried in European Union accomponied by our Support Centre in Lithuania and Manufacturers and Warehouses in East Asia.

We cut out all the middle men and deliver the products directly to consumers from our manufacturers which allows us to offer extremely low prices.

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

Om oss

A. Generelle spørsmål

1. Er dette nettstedet sikkert å bruke?

Det er det absolutt. Vi bruker PayPal for å behandle betalinger. Så ikke engang vårt personale får se betalingsdetaljene dine. PayPal er verdens største sikre betalingsleverandør. Nettstedet vårt er bygget på Shopify sin sikre plattform. All din personlige informasjon er godt beskyttet.

 

2. Hvor raskt svarer dere på e-posthenvendelser?

Vi svarer på alle e-poster innen én virkedag.

 

3. Hvor holder dere til?

Vår hovedvirksomhet drives i EU, støttet av vårt kundesenter i Litauen og produsenter og lagre i Øst-Asia.

 

4. Hvorfor er dere så billige?

Vi kutter ut alle mellomledd og leverer produktene direkte til forbrukerne fra våre produsenter, noe som gjør at vi kan tilby ekstremt lave priser.

Før du legger inn en bestilling

A. Størrelser

1. Hvor kan jeg finne størrelsestabellen i centimeter?

Bruk størrelsestabellen for det bestemte produktet og den størrelsen du vurderer. Kontroller måleenhetene og om tabellen viser kroppsmål eller plaggets mål. Vår størrelsesguide forklarer hvordan du måler og sammenligner størrelser. Kontakt oss før du bestiller hvis en tabell eller et mål er uklart.

 

2. Vil jeg motta et plagg som er to størrelser større?

Størrelsesbetegnelser og mål varierer med produkt og produsent. Velg hvert plagg ut fra produktets egen størrelsestabell og de tilgjengelige alternativene, i stedet for å anta at din vanlige bokstavstørrelse passer eller bruke en fast størrelsesomregning. Kontakt oss før du bestiller hvis du er usikker.

B. Betalinger

1. Hvilke betalingsmetoder godtar dere?

Vi godtar PayPal og kreditt-/debetkort (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover).

 

2. Jeg vil betale med kredittkort, men blir omdirigert til PayPal-siden?

Vi bruker PayPal for å behandle alle betalingene våre. På PayPal-siden til høyre kan du velge mellom to alternativer: "Betal med min PayPal-konto" eller "Betal med mitt kreditt- eller debetkort"

C. Frakt

1. Hva er fraktprisen?

Vi tilbyr helt GRATIS levering over hele verden.

 

2. Leverer dere til mitt land?

Ja, det gjør vi. Vi leverer til alle land i hele verden.

 

3. Hvor lang tid tar det å få bestillingen min?

Leveringen tar vanligvis omtrent 15-30 dager. Du kan imidlertid sjekke nøyaktige leveringsestimater her: Frakt-side

 

4. Må jeg betale toll?

Nei, du trenger ikke å betale tollavgift. Vi merker alle bestillingene våre som gaver med lav verdi. Dessuten sender vi større bestillinger i separate pakker.

Etter at du har lagt inn en bestilling

A. Bestillingsstatus

1. Hva betyr det: bestillingsstatus "Uoppfylt"?

Bestillingen din behandles, og sporingsnummeret for bestillingen er under behandling. Vi pleier å fullføre bestillingene og sende kundene våre sporingsnummeret når bestillingens sporingsnummer er sendt til postsystemet, noe som tar 5-7 dager etter at bestillingen allerede er sendt.

 

2. Hva betyr det: bestillingsstatus "Fulfilled"?

Det betyr at bestillingen din er under sending.

 

3. Det har gått for lang tid, hvor er bestillingen min?

Vennligst sjekk sporingen for mer informasjon. Hvis problemet vedvarer, vennligst send oss en e-post: support@dresslikemommy.com

B. Bestillingssporing

1. Hvordan sporer jeg bestillingen min?

Vi gir deg sporingskoden 5-7 dager etter at du har lagt inn bestillingen. Du kan spore bestillingen her: Spor bestillingen din

 

2. Sporingskoden min sier «venter» eller «ingen informasjon tilgjengelig for øyeblikket».

Noen ganger vises de første sporingsresultatene 5-10 virkedager etter at du mottar sporingsnummeret. Hvis problemet vedvarer i mer enn 10 virkedager, vennligst kontakt oss: support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Sporingskoden min sier «utløpt»

Vennligst kontakt oss: support@dresslikemommy.com og vi vil raskt løse dette problemet.

 

4. Hvordan holder jeg meg oppdatert om bestillingssporing?

Vi bruker After Ship sporing for å følge opp kundebestillinger, så når sporingsinformasjonen oppdateres, vil du motta en e-post.

B. Jeg vil endre eller avbestille bestillingen min

1. Jeg bestilte noe, men vil avbestille

Du må kontakte oss innen 1 virkedag etter at bestillingen er lagt inn for å ordne en endring. Du kan gjøre dette ved å sende e-post til support@dresslikemommy.com med bestillingsnummeret ditt som emne.

 

2. Jeg bestilte noe, men vil endre farge eller størrelse på varen.

Du må kontakte oss innen 1 virkedag etter at bestillingen er lagt inn for å ordne en endring. Du kan gjøre dette ved å sende e-post til support@dresslikemommy.com med ditt nye farge- eller størrelsevalg.

 

3. Jeg bestilte noe, men vil endre leveringsadressen

Du må kontakte oss innen 1 virkedag etter at bestillingen er lagt inn for å ordne en endring. Du kan gjøre dette ved å sende e-post til support@dresslikemommy.com med din nye leveringsadresse.

Etter at du mottar en bestilling

A. Jeg vil bytte eller returnere bestillingen min

1. Bestillingen min kom, men varene var to størrelser for store

Størrelsesbetegnelser kan variere. Hvis størrelsen eller målene ikke ser ut til å samsvare med bestillingen din, kontakt support@dresslikemommy.com med ordrenummeret og detaljene. Les våre gjeldende retningslinjer for refusjon før du sender en vare tilbake.

 

2. Bestillingen min kom, men jeg mottok feil varer

Vennligst kontakt oss på support@dresslikemommy.com og oppgi bestillingsnummeret ditt. Hvis feilen er vår, kan du sende varene tilbake, og vi sender deg riktige varer på vår regning (eller utsteder refusjon).

 

3. Bestillingen min kom, og jeg vil bytte størrelse/farge

Vennligst kontakt oss på support@dresslikemommy.com og oppgi bestillingsnummeret ditt. Du kan sende varen tilbake til oss, og vi vil sende deg en ny vare i oppdatert størrelse. *Portokostnader dekkes av deg.

 

4. Bestillingen min kom, men jeg vil returnere den.

Vennligst kontakt oss på support@dresslikemommy.com og oppgi bestillingsnummeret ditt. Du kan sende varen tilbake til oss, og vi vil utstede en refusjon. *Portokostnader dekkes av deg.

Standardfrakt er inkludert i produktprisene for land og regioner der en standard fraktmetode er tilgjengelig. Den nøyaktige fraktmetoden, forventet leveringstid og eventuelle oppgraderinger til ekspressfrakt vises i kassen før betaling.

Behandlings- og transporttider varierer etter reisemål og transportør. Les fraktvilkårene for oppdaterte leveringsopplysninger før du går til kassen.

Bruk sporingslenken for å se de siste oppdateringene fra transportøren. Hvis pakken er forsinket, borte eller merket som levert uten at du har mottatt den, kontakter du oss med bestillingsnummeret og sporingsinformasjonen.

O nas

A. Pytania ogólne

1. Czy korzystanie z tej strony jest bezpieczne?

Tak. Płatności są bezpiecznie obsługiwane przez Shopify, z wykorzystaniem metod widocznych podczas składania zamówienia. Nie przechowujemy na naszej stronie pełnych danych karty.

 

2. Jak szybko odpowiadacie na pytania e-mailowe?

Na wszystkie wiadomości odpowiadamy w ciągu jednego dnia roboczego.

 

3. Gdzie mieści się firma?

Dress Like Mommy to sklep internetowy prowadzony przez FKG Trading LLC w Naples na Florydzie w USA. Współpracujemy z partnerami produkcyjnymi i realizującymi zamówienia.

 

4. Skąd tak niskie ceny?

Dobieramy pasujące stroje rodzinne z myślą o przystępnych cenach. Ceny i dostępne rabaty są widoczne na stronie produktu oraz przy składaniu zamówienia.

Przed złożeniem zamówienia

A. Rozmiary

1. Gdzie znajdę tabelę rozmiarów w centymetrach?

Skorzystaj z tabeli rozmiarów konkretnego produktu i rozmiaru, który rozważasz. Sprawdź jednostki oraz to, czy tabela podaje wymiary ciała, czy ubrania. Nasz przewodnik po rozmiarach wyjaśnia, jak dokonywać pomiarów i porównywać rozmiary. Jeśli tabela lub pomiar są niejasne, skontaktuj się z nami przed zamówieniem.

 

2. Czy otrzymam produkt o dwa rozmiary większy?

Oznaczenia rozmiarów i wymiary różnią się w zależności od produktu i producenta. Wybieraj każdy produkt na podstawie jego tabeli rozmiarów i dostępnych wariantów, zamiast zakładać swój zwykły rozmiar literowy lub stosować stały przelicznik. W razie wątpliwości skontaktuj się z nami przed zamówieniem.

B. Płatności

1. Jakie metody płatności akceptujecie?

Akceptujemy metody płatności wyświetlane przy składaniu zamówienia, w tym dostępne opcje płatności kartą.

 

2. Chcę zapłacić kartą kredytową, ale następuje przekierowanie do PayPal.

Wybierz dostępną metodę płatności przy składaniu zamówienia. Jeśli wybierzesz opcję obsługiwaną przez zewnętrznego dostawcę, postępuj zgodnie z jego instrukcjami lub wybierz inną dostępną metodę przed zapłatą.

C. Wysyłka

1. Ile kosztuje wysyłka?

Standardowa wysyłka jest wliczona w ceny produktów dla krajów i regionów, w których dostępna jest standardowa metoda wysyłki. Przed zapłatą wyświetlane są dokładna metoda wysyłki, przewidywany termin dostawy i ewentualna opcja dostawy ekspresowej.

 

2. Czy dostarczacie do mojego kraju?

Wysyłamy do krajów i regionów widocznych podczas finalizacji zakupu. Jeśli Twojego kraju nie ma na tej liście, skontaktuj się z nami przed złożeniem zamówienia.

 

3. Jak długo będę czekać na zamówienie?

Czas realizacji i transportu zależy od miejsca dostawy i przewoźnika. Przed złożeniem zamówienia zapoznaj się z polityką wysyłki zawierającą aktualne informacje o dostawie.

 

4. Czy muszę zapłacić cło?

Kraj docelowy może naliczyć cło, podatki importowe lub opłaty lokalne, za które odpowiada klient, chyba że podczas finalizacji zakupu wyraźnie wskazano, że są one wliczone. Nie możemy oznaczać zamówień jako prezentów ani jako przesyłek o niższej wartości.

Po złożeniu zamówienia

A. Status zamówienia

1. Co oznacza status zamówienia „Unfulfilled” (niezrealizowane)?

Twoje zamówienie nie zostało jeszcze oznaczone jako zrealizowane. Zamówienia są zwykle przygotowywane w ciągu 1-3 dni roboczych od potwierdzenia płatności. Dostępne informacje o śledzeniu wysyłamy e-mailem po nadaniu przesyłki.

 

2. Co oznacza status zamówienia „Fulfilled” (zrealizowane)?

Oznacza to, że Twoje zamówienie jest wysyłane.

 

3. Minęło dużo czasu. Gdzie jest moje zamówienie?

Sprawdź informacje o śledzeniu zamówienia. Jeśli problem nadal występuje, napisz do nas: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Śledzenie zamówienia

1. Jak śledzić zamówienie?

Informacje o śledzeniu wysyłamy e-mailem, gdy są dostępne po nadaniu zamówienia. Możesz też sprawdzić je tutaj: Śledź zamówienie

 

2. Przy numerze śledzenia widnieje „oczekuje” lub „informacje są obecnie niedostępne”.

Aktualizacja informacji o śledzeniu może potrwać 24-48 godzin od nadania numeru. Jeśli informacje nadal są niedostępne lub przesyłka jest opóźniona, skontaktuj się z nami: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Przy numerze śledzenia widnieje „wygasł”.

Skontaktuj się z nami: info@dresslikemommy.com a szybko rozwiążemy ten problem.

 

4. Jak być na bieżąco ze śledzeniem zamówienia?

Korzystaj z linku śledzenia, aby uzyskać najnowsze informacje od przewoźnika. Jeśli przesyłka jest opóźniona, zaginęła lub została oznaczona jako doręczona, ale jej nie otrzymano, skontaktuj się z nami, podając numer zamówienia i dane śledzenia.

B. Chcę zmienić lub anulować zamówienie

1. Złożono zamówienie, ale chcę je anulować.

Aby ustalić zmianę zamówienia, należy skontaktować się z nami w ciągu 1 dnia roboczego od jego złożenia. Możesz napisać na adres info@dresslikemommy.com wpisując numer zamówienia w temacie wiadomości.

 

2. Złożono zamówienie, ale chcę zmienić kolor lub rozmiar produktu.

Aby ustalić zmianę zamówienia, należy skontaktować się z nami w ciągu 1 dnia roboczego od jego złożenia. Możesz napisać na adres info@dresslikemommy.com podając nowy kolor lub rozmiar.

 

3. Złożono zamówienie, ale chcę zmienić adres dostawy.

Aby ustalić zmianę zamówienia, należy skontaktować się z nami w ciągu 1 dnia roboczego od jego złożenia. Możesz napisać na adres info@dresslikemommy.com podając nowy adres dostawy.

Po otrzymaniu zamówienia

A. Chcę wymienić lub zwrócić zamówienie

1. Zamówienie dotarło, ale produkty są o dwa rozmiary większe.

Oznaczenia rozmiarów mogą się różnić. Jeśli rozmiar lub wymiary wydają się niezgodne z zamówieniem, napisz na info@dresslikemommy.com, podając numer zamówienia i szczegóły. Przed odesłaniem produktu zapoznaj się z aktualną polityką zwrotów.

 

2. Zamówienie dotarło, ale otrzymano niewłaściwe produkty.

Napisz do nas na adres info@dresslikemommy.com i podaj numer zamówienia. Jeśli błąd leży po naszej stronie, możesz odesłać produkty, a my wyślemy właściwe na nasz koszt lub zwrócimy pieniądze.

 

3. Zamówienie dotarło i chcę zmienić rozmiar lub kolor.

Napisz do nas na adres info@dresslikemommy.com i podaj numer zamówienia. Zatwierdzone wymiany podlegają aktualnej polityce zwrotów, w tym wymaganiom dotyczącym stanu produktu i odpowiedzialności za koszty odesłania.

 

4. Zamówienie dotarło, ale chcę je zwrócić.

Napisz do nas na adres info@dresslikemommy.com i podaj numer zamówienia. Przed odesłaniem czegokolwiek zapoznaj się z zasadami kwalifikacji do zwrotu, kosztami odesłania i terminami refundacji.

Sobre nós

A. Perguntas Gerais

1. Este site é seguro para usar?

Com certeza é seguro. Usamos PayPal para processar pagamentos. Assim, nem mesmo nossa equipe vê seus dados de pagamento. PayPal é o maior provedor de pagamento seguro do mundo. Nosso site é construído na plataforma segura Shopify. Todas as suas informações pessoais estão protegidas.

 

2. Com que rapidez vocês respondem às consultas por e-mail?

Respondemos todos os e-mails dentro de um dia útil.

 

3. Onde vocês estão localizados?

Nossas principais operações são realizadas na União Europeia, acompanhadas pelo nosso Centro de Suporte na Lituânia e pelos Fabricantes e Armazéns no Leste Asiático.

 

4. Por que vocês são tão baratos?

Eliminamos todos os intermediários e entregamos os produtos diretamente aos consumidores a partir de nossos fabricantes, o que nos permite oferecer preços extremamente baixos.

Antes de Você Fazer um Pedido

A. Tamanhos

1. Onde posso encontrar a tabela de tamanhos em centímetros?

Use a tabela de tamanhos específica do produto e do tamanho que você está considerando. Confira as unidades e se a tabela apresenta medidas do corpo ou da peça. Nosso guia de tamanhos explica como tirar medidas e comparar tamanhos. Se uma tabela ou medida não estiver clara, entre em contato conosco antes de fazer o pedido.

 

2. Vou receber um item dois tamanhos maior?

As etiquetas de tamanho e as medidas variam conforme o produto e o fabricante. Escolha cada peça usando sua tabela de tamanhos específica e as opções disponíveis, em vez de presumir que seu tamanho habitual em letras será adequado ou aplicar uma conversão fixa de tamanhos. Em caso de dúvida, entre em contato conosco antes de fazer o pedido.

B. Pagamentos

1. Quais tipos de pagamento vocês aceitam?

Aceitamos PayPal e cartões de crédito/débito (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover).

 

2. Quero pagar com meu cartão de crédito, mas sou redirecionado para a página do PayPal?

Usamos PayPal para processar todos os nossos pagamentos. Na página do PayPal à direita, você pode escolher entre duas opções: "Pagar com minha conta PayPal" ou "Pagar com meu cartão de crédito ou débito"

C. Envio

1. Qual é o preço do frete?

Oferecemos entrega absolutamente GRÁTIS para todo o mundo.

 

2. Vocês entregam no meu país?

Sim, entregamos. Fazemos entregas para todos os países do mundo.

 

3. Quanto tempo levará para receber meu pedido?

A entrega geralmente leva cerca de 15 a 30 dias. No entanto, você pode verificar as estimativas exatas de entrega aqui: Página de Envio

 

4. Preciso pagar alguma taxa de alfândega?

Não, você não precisa pagar taxa de alfândega. Marcamos todos os nossos pedidos como presentes de baixo valor. Além disso, enviamos pedidos maiores em pacotes separados.

Após Você Fazer um Pedido

A. Status do Pedido

1. O que significa: status do pedido "Não Cumprido"?

Seu pedido está sendo processado e o número de rastreamento do pedido está pendente. Normalmente, cumprimos os pedidos e enviamos aos nossos clientes o número de rastreamento quando o número de rastreamento do pedido é submetido ao Sistema Postal, o que leva de 5 a 7 dias após o pedido já ter sido enviado.

 

2. O que significa: status do pedido "Fulfilled"?

Isso significa que seu pedido está sendo enviado.

 

3. Já faz muito tempo, onde está meu pedido?

Por favor, verifique o rastreamento do seu pedido para mais informações. Se o problema persistir, envie um e-mail para nós: support@dresslikemommy.com

B. Rastreamento de Pedido

1. Como faço para rastrear meu pedido?

Fornecemos o código de rastreamento do pedido 5-7 dias após você fazer o pedido. Você pode rastrear seu pedido aqui: Rastrear Seu Pedido

 

2. Meu código de rastreamento diz “pendente” ou “nenhuma informação disponível no momento”.

Às vezes, os primeiros resultados de rastreamento aparecem 5-10 dias úteis após você receber o número de rastreamento do pedido. Se o problema persistir por mais de 10 dias úteis, por favor entre em contato conosco: support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Meu código de rastreamento diz “expirado”

Por favor, entre em contato conosco: support@dresslikemommy.com e resolveremos esse problema rapidamente.

 

4. Como posso me manter atualizado sobre o rastreamento do meu pedido?

Usamos o sistema de rastreamento After Ship para acompanhar os pedidos dos nossos clientes, então sempre que a informação de rastreamento for atualizada, você deve receber um e-mail.

B. Quero trocar ou cancelar meu pedido

1. Eu pedi algo, mas quero cancelar

Você deve entrar em contato conosco dentro de 1 dia útil após fazer o pedido para organizar a troca do pedido. Você pode fazer isso enviando um e-mail para support@dresslikemommy.com com o número do seu pedido no assunto.

 

2. Eu pedi algo, mas quero mudar a cor ou tamanho do item.

Você deve entrar em contato conosco dentro de 1 dia útil após fazer o pedido para organizar a troca do pedido. Você pode fazer isso enviando um e-mail para support@dresslikemommy.com com sua nova opção de cor ou tamanho.

 

3. Eu pedi algo, mas quero mudar o endereço de entrega

Você deve entrar em contato conosco dentro de 1 dia útil após fazer o pedido para organizar a troca do pedido. Você pode fazer isso enviando um e-mail para support@dresslikemommy.com com seu novo endereço de entrega.

Após você receber um pedido

A. Quero trocar ou devolver meu pedido

1. Meu pedido chegou, mas os itens estavam dois tamanhos maiores

As etiquetas de tamanho podem variar. Se o tamanho ou as medidas parecerem não corresponder ao seu pedido, entre em contato pelo e-mail support@dresslikemommy.com com o número do pedido e os detalhes. Consulte nossa política de reembolso atual antes de devolver uma peça.

 

2. Meu pedido chegou, mas recebi os itens errados

Por favor, entre em contato conosco em support@dresslikemommy.com e nos forneça o número do seu pedido. Se o erro for nosso, você pode nos devolver os itens e nós enviaremos os itens corretos por nossa conta (ou emitiremos um reembolso).

 

3. Meu pedido chegou e quero trocar o tamanho/cor

Por favor, entre em contato conosco em support@dresslikemommy.com e nos forneça o número do seu pedido. Você pode nos enviar o item de volta e nós enviaremos um novo item com o tamanho atualizado. *Os custos de postagem serão por sua conta.

 

4. Meu pedido chegou, mas quero devolvê-lo.

Por favor, entre em contato conosco em support@dresslikemommy.com e nos forneça o número do seu pedido. Você pode nos enviar o item de volta e nós emitiremos um reembolso. *Os custos de postagem serão por sua conta.

C. Envio

1. Qual é o preço do frete?

O frete padrão está incluído nos preços dos produtos para os países e regiões onde há uma modalidade padrão disponível. Antes do pagamento, são exibidos a modalidade exata, a estimativa de entrega e qualquer opção de frete expresso.

 

2. Vocês entregam no meu país?

Enviamos para os países e regiões exibidos na finalização da compra. Se o seu país não estiver na lista, entre em contato conosco antes de fazer um pedido.

O país de destino pode cobrar taxas alfandegárias, impostos de importação ou taxas locais, que são de responsabilidade do cliente, a menos que a finalização da compra informe expressamente que estão incluídos. Não podemos declarar os pedidos como presentes nem como remessas de valor inferior.

2. O que significa: status do pedido "Fulfilled"?

Isso significa que seu pedido está sendo enviado.

 

3. Já faz muito tempo, onde está meu pedido?

Por favor, verifique o rastreamento do seu pedido para mais informações. Se o problema persistir, envie um e-mail para nós: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Rastreamento de Pedido

1. Como faço para rastrear meu pedido?

As informações de rastreamento são enviadas por e-mail quando ficam disponíveis após o envio do pedido. Você também pode consultá-las aqui: Rastrear seu pedido

 

2. Meu código de rastreamento diz “pendente” ou “nenhuma informação disponível no momento”.

O rastreamento pode levar 24-48 horas para ser atualizado após a emissão do código. Se as informações continuarem indisponíveis ou se sua encomenda estiver atrasada, entre em contato: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Meu código de rastreamento diz “expirado”

Por favor, entre em contato conosco: info@dresslikemommy.com e resolveremos esse problema rapidamente.

 

4. Como posso me manter atualizado sobre o rastreamento do meu pedido?

Use o link de rastreamento para ver as atualizações mais recentes da transportadora. Se a encomenda estiver atrasada, desaparecida ou marcada como entregue sem ter sido recebida, entre em contato com o número do pedido e as informações de rastreamento.

B. Quero trocar ou cancelar meu pedido

1. Eu pedi algo, mas quero cancelar

Você deve entrar em contato conosco dentro de 1 dia útil após fazer o pedido para organizar a troca do pedido. Você pode fazer isso enviando um e-mail para info@dresslikemommy.com com o número do seu pedido no assunto.

 

2. Eu pedi algo, mas quero mudar a cor ou tamanho do item.

Você deve entrar em contato conosco dentro de 1 dia útil após fazer o pedido para organizar a troca do pedido. Você pode fazer isso enviando um e-mail para info@dresslikemommy.com com sua nova opção de cor ou tamanho.

 

3. Eu pedi algo, mas quero mudar o endereço de entrega

Você deve entrar em contato conosco dentro de 1 dia útil após fazer o pedido para organizar a troca do pedido. Você pode fazer isso enviando um e-mail para info@dresslikemommy.com com seu novo endereço de entrega.

Após você receber um pedido

A. Quero trocar ou devolver meu pedido

1. Meu pedido chegou, mas os itens estavam dois tamanhos maiores

As etiquetas de tamanho podem variar. Se o tamanho ou as medidas parecerem não corresponder ao seu pedido, entre em contato pelo e-mail info@dresslikemommy.com com o número do pedido e os detalhes. Consulte nossa política de reembolso atual antes de devolver uma peça.

 

2. Meu pedido chegou, mas recebi os itens errados

Por favor, entre em contato conosco em info@dresslikemommy.com e nos forneça o número do seu pedido. Se o erro for nosso, você pode nos devolver os itens e nós enviaremos os itens corretos por nossa conta (ou emitiremos um reembolso).

 

3. Meu pedido chegou e quero trocar o tamanho/cor

Entre em contato pelo e-mail info@dresslikemommy.com e informe o número do pedido. As trocas aprovadas seguem a política de reembolso vigente, incluindo os requisitos sobre o estado do produto e a responsabilidade pelos custos do frete de devolução.

 

4. Meu pedido chegou, mas quero devolvê-lo.

Entre em contato pelo e-mail info@dresslikemommy.com e informe o número do pedido. Antes de devolver qualquer item, consulte a política de reembolso para verificar os requisitos de elegibilidade, o frete de devolução e os prazos de reembolso.

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility, unless checkout explicitly says they are included. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at support@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at support@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at support@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.
